name: Thunder Call
tagline: Summon lightning that crackles around you.

motion: The sky darkens and wind picks up around {subject}. They look up as crackling blue-white electricity arcs between their fingers, then a bolt of lightning strikes behind them, flooding the scene with light as sparks dance across their shoulders and hair lifts with static. Low-angle camera.
